name: Velocity Pivot
description: Inputting a value of 0 will cause it to stop. The pivot's current rotation can be read from its output. An output of 1 corresponds to one full turn, and -1 to a full turn in the opposite direction.
shortDescription: A pivot that will continuously rotate at a set input speed.

logicNodes.label: Rotational Speed
logicNodes.description: The speed at which the pivot should rotate.

logicNodes.label: Current Rotation
logicNodes.description: The pivot's measured rotation expressed in fractions of full turns.
